metadata.name: lfm2-audio-python-source-smoke
metadata.description: Local source-load: manifest plugin entry points at a directory containing plugin.toml. Resolver dispatches to SourcePythonFactory, provisions a uv venv with torch+liquid-audio+transformers, spawns the runner, and registers LFM2AudioNode.

params.system_prompt: Respond with interleaved text and audio.
